inspiration: Window frame as a 9-slice with a thick top rail for the title and thin sides (data/styles/10-windows.otui sets image-border 6 and image-border-top 27). Recreate as our own panel with a heavier header and an inset content area. Reference: data/images/ui/window.png.

One cooldown effect built from a single particle texture: a radial burst of many short particles, a colour ramp from clear to white to hot orange over under half a second, then an inward pull. Recreate with our own burst shape (shards or sparks) and our own ramp. Reference: data/particles/particles.otps.

Status icon set: about seventeen small state icons (bleeding, burning, cursed, dazzled, drowning, drunk, electrified, freezing, haste, hungry, poisoned, slowed and more) that read as a row. Recreate with one outline style and a silhouette per effect, not colour alone. Reference: data/images/game/states/.

Summon ownership as a pair of icons, one for your own summon and one for others. Recreate as a contrasting pair with different glyph shapes. Reference: data/images/game/creaturetype/summon_own.png and summon_other.png (names only; pixels not viewed).

Small bitmap UI font in a fixed glyph cell with tight negative spacing, as a separate atlas plus a metrics file. Recreate with our own face and glyph design, keeping the cell-and-metrics format. Reference: data/fonts/verdana-11px-rounded.otfont.
Cursors as small sprites with a named hot-spot per use (target, text, horizontal, vertical). Recreate with our own shapes. Reference: data/cursors/cursors.otml.
Minimap markers as a numbered flag set (flag0 to flag12) plus a cross marker on a 16 px grid. Recreate as our own marker family. Reference: data/images/game/minimap/.

briefs.label: Ember ring burst
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Reads at 375 wide as a small ring. Signature effect: a radial burst that pulls inward and fades. Colour story: clear to white to hot orange. Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's burst.
keep: colour ramp from clear to bright
short life under half a second
change: a pull outward instead of inward

briefs.label: Status effect icon row
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. About seventeen small state icons read as a row at 16 px. Signature behaviour: each state is its own small icon, shown in a row (names only; pixels not viewed). Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's icon set.
change: a silhouette per effect, not colour alone

briefs.label: Thick-topped panel frame
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. The title rail is much taller than the sides, so the header reads first at 375 wide. Silhouette: a heavy top bar. Target 20-30 percent resemblance to the donor's frame.

briefs.label: Own and other summon pair
briefs.why: Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Two icons for ownership of a summon; the pair is the idea, not the glyph. Pixels not viewed, so this brief rests on file names only.
keep: a pair that differs by one cue
